title: Rollback/rebuild frontend to draft version 88 and complete build+deploy with smoke checks

requirements.summary: Restore the frontend codebase to match draft version 88 exactly and verify all required pages load and navigate without runtime errors.

No runtime errors or blank-screen/fallback error UI occurs during initial page load and basic navigation between pages.
